exact_blockers.requirement: Supply an exact licensed PBFDAF/AUMDF reference implementation or runtime with immutable revision, license terms and reproducible build/run instructions.
Provide a rights record covering code/runtime use, fixtures, and any paired render/capture assets needed for qualification.
Provide a rights-cleared paired render/capture cohort with frozen echo-only, near-end-only, double-talk, path-change and no-reference conditions.
Execute a task-matched MDF/PBFDAF comparison on the same frozen cohort; record convergence, ERLE, near-end preservation and cost.
Measure algorithmic/content delay, availability, memory and deadline behavior for the exact runtime/device profile.
Complete opt-in provider intake, descriptor/license review and independent exact-head review before any registration or default.

gates.requirement: Pin an exact licensed PBFDAF/AUMDF reference source/runtime revision, license terms and redistribution/usage scope.
Clear rights for code, weights if any, fixtures, and any paired render/capture assets required for qualification.
Provide a rights-cleared paired render/capture cohort with frozen room, delay, movement, noise and reset schedule per Room profile.
Run identity/noisy controls and a task-matched MDF/reference baseline on the same frozen cohort with exact configuration pins.
Measure echo attenuation, near-end damage, double-talk, path change, delayed/missing render and nonfinite/invalid rejection.
Measure content/availability timing, memory, deadline behavior and callback suitability on target runtime/device conditions.
Complete opt-in provider intake, descriptor review, license review and independent exact-head review before any registration.
Record explicit default/release decision only after qualification gates close; no default or release claim in this package.

qualification.reason: No exact licensed PBFDAF/AUMDF reference/runtime, rights record, paired render/capture cohort, MDF comparison, or timing evidence is present; only bounded synthetic accounting controls exist.

room_profile_requirements.requirement: Freeze render/reference or measured RIRs, channel/rate/hop, excitation, delay, movement, noise and reset schedule.
Include echo-only, near-end-only, double-talk and no-reference cases.
Report echo attenuation, near-end damage, nonfinite failures and alignments, including delayed/missing render.
A no-reference suppressor gets its own independent comparison.

stable_fields.acceptance: Apply the room acceptance profile; record exact scope, evidence, failure/control results, and remaining release gates. A readiness conclusion with an exact external blocker is an accepted investigation handoff; it does not close the conditional implementation.
stable_fields.deliverable: Verify runnable source, exact assets, permitted scope, task geometry and matched evidence. Then implement or wrap a minimal reference using the relevant public adapter boundary and ship it as optional initially. Record a concrete blocker if feasibility fails. Prototype a partitioned baseline and compare long-tail convergence with MDF.
stable_fields.title: PBFDAF / AUMDF
write_scope: SDK provider, tool or evidence directory for pbfdaf-aumdf and its own fixtures
